annotations.title: Interact with a page, then capture it

description: Load a web page in a real browser through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com), run ordered browser actions on it (click, type into a search box, choose an option, press a key, scroll, wait), then return the resulting HTML. Discover selectors with list_elements first. Steps act on the website and are NOT idempotent - they run once per call and are not retried; never use them to buy, post, delete or change anything unless the user asked for exactly that. A failed step returns which step failed plus the page HTML at that point. Billed as one request.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load.

steps.description: Ordered browser actions to run after the page loads (wait_for, wait_for_text, wait, click, type [human-like], select, press_key, scroll), then the HTML is captured.

selector.description: CSS selector the action targets (required for wait_for/click/type/select).

value.description: Action payload: text to type/select, text for wait_for_text, a key name for press_key (e.g. 'Enter'), milliseconds for wait, or 'bottom'/pixels for scroll.

wait_method.description: Optional render-wait before the steps: 'css' selector or 'js' expression.
